question: Linganamakki Dam is built across which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sharavathi,**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Linganamakki Dam located in the Kargal village of Sagara taluk, **Karnataka,**
 
• It was constructed by the Karnataka State Government in **1964. **
 
• Linganamakki Dam is built across the **Sharavathi river.**__
 
• The dam has a length of 2.74 kilometres stretching across the Sharavathi river.
 
• It is located near** Jog Falls.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Sharavati**__ is a river in Karnataka, India, that originates and flows fully within the state.

 __
 
• The Sharavati originates in the Karnataka district of **Shimoga** and drains a catchment area of 2,209 square kilometres.
 
• It is one of India's few **westward-flowing rivers.**
 
• The Western Ghats make up a large section of the river basin.
 
• The river and the surrounding area are both rich in biodiversity, with numerous uncommon species of flora and fauna.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dams built across the **Krishna river** are:

 
 
• Almatti Dam.
 
• Nagarjuna Sagar Dam.
 
• Srisailam Dam.
 
 
 
• Pampa Sagar Dam, commonly known as Tungabhadra Dam, is a multipurpose dam built across the **Tungabhadra River.**
 
• The Lakhwar-Vyasi Dam project is built on the **Yamuna River.**
